comparison.objective: Select ISO color-coded 02 nozzles and fit six to a boom; not tune a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual part selection and repeated nozzle attachment versus recessed hex-key use, fine collar rotation, counterholding, and dynamic iteration.
comparison.success_condition: All six bodies fitted with the correct coded size versus repeatable safe impacts and retained collar setting.
comparison.reason: Repeated fitting and maintenance context do not establish the same tested ability. Attachment mechanism, torque, scoring tolerances, and specs are absent.
